top_signals.title: US Launches Fresh Wave of Iran Strikes as Conflict Widens Across Middle East
top_signals.summary: The US hit dozens of military targets in a fresh wave of strikes on Iran in response to an attack on American forces in Jordan. Iran targeted a building in northern Kuwait while Jordan said it intercepted five missiles from the Islamic Republic as the conflict escalates and spreads across the Middle East. Tyler Kendall reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Bank of England Leaves Interest Rates Unchanged
top_signals.summary: The Bank of England's Monetary Policy Committee voted six-three in favor of keeping interest rates on hold at 3.75%. UK officials sought to balance the threat from US-Iran tensions against signs that domestic price pressures are easing more quickly than expected. Bloomberg's Lizzy Burden reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
